title: Page 6
content_zh:
“请等、等一下！”
乔若曦匆匆忙忙从店里跑出来，男人因为她的呼唤而停下步伐。
她气喘吁吁，脸蛋红通通的，不过那不只是因为跑步的关系。
她始终低着头，映入眼帘的是男人的黑色靴子。她没有勇气开口，甚至连抬起头的勇气也没有，心脏怦怦的跳，像是要跳出胸口一样，刚刚冲出店里的那股冲动不知道跑到哪里去了。
她偷偷喜欢这个人已经很久了，他是咖啡屋的常客，那温文儒雅的气质、高瘦挺拔的身躯，还有笑起来带点邪气的英俊脸庞，在在让她迷恋不已。
本来已经决定了永远不说，她也知道自己的条件配不上人家，只是一个小咖啡屋的老板，外表顶多算是清秀而已，除了烹饪、泡咖啡以外也没有什么特殊的优点……
呜……真是越想越绝望吶！
但今天听到他跟朋友说即将到外地工作，以后来咖啡屋吃饭的机会就不多了时，她慌了，以后就再也看不到他了！
她得试试！她得告白，就算被拒绝，也好过什么都不说，徒留遗憾。
奇怪，刚刚明明就是这么告诉自己的，怎么她好不容易鼓起的勇气，现在却像破了洞的气球一样“咻”的扁掉。
“有什么事？”男人低沉的嗓音在头颅上方响起。
她的心跳更快了，困难的吞了口口水，头压的更低。她没办法抬头直视男人，涨得通红的脸实在太丢人了。
“是我们忘了什么东西在店里吗？”另一个悦耳的男性嗓音响起。
她知道她得开口了，否则他一定会开始觉得她是个怪女人。
好吧！豁、豁出去了！
“我、我喜欢你！对不起，我喜欢你很久了，每次你来店里用餐我都忍不住注意你。可、可以请你跟我交往吗？”
在她说完这些话之后是一段长长的沉默。
乔若曦闭着眼睛，像是等待死亡判决的囚犯。
“咳，你、你说真的？”那低沉的嗓音又响起，这回似乎带着些许的腼觍。
“是真的！”她用力点头。“我知道我这样说让你很困扰，对不起！你可以不用管我。我只是想要跟你说我的心情。”

“不、不会怪你。”那声音有些慌乱。“既然、既然你那么说的话——”
一旁传来爽朗的笑声。“呵呵！不错喔！大熊，竟然有这么可爱的小姑娘喜欢你。你走运了。”
大、大熊？
乔若曦终于察觉有异。有种不好的预感油然而生，因为她喜欢的男子高姚帅气，实在很难跟“大熊”这种绰号联想在一起。倒是他身边的好友，那个高大雄壮、肌肉结实、蓄着平头，看来像是黑社会老大的男人……
她心里一突，猛地抬起头。
她面前站的是那名粗壮的熊男！以往他总是跟高姚男子一起来店里，两人似乎是好友，他总是面无表情的吃东西，三、两下就可以把所有食物扫光，很少讲话，因此看起来很恐怖。可是现在他脸上却带着一抹尴尬，难得慌了手脚的模样。
死、死了……她该不会……不，似乎是真的——她，告白错对象了？
一旁的高姚男眼角含笑的看着她。“想不到你会喜欢上大熊，我还以为你很怕他，每次来店里你都不敢看他，送完餐也都很快离开，我还以为你跟其它女孩子一样被大熊粗壮的外表吓到了。原来你是暗恋他啊！呵呵……不错喔！我这朋友虽然看起来很像坏人，可是其实人很好，当男朋友更是绝佳的人选。”
乔若曦快哭出来了。
不、不、不！她不是暗恋他！她是真的怕他啊！
怎么会搞成这样？她平常是迷迷糊糊没错，可是想不到会迷糊到犯了这种错。现在她该怎么解释自己是站错位置、告白错对象？
脸色苍白，她全身微微的发着抖。
“对、对不起……那个，忘了我说的吧！”
她低下头，恨不得有个地洞可以钻，现在她只想立刻冲回店里，把这一切都忘记，忘记这个乌龙，然后狠狠捶自己的头。
白痴啊——她是个无可救药的白痴——呜……
转身想离开，但手臂却被抓住，那粗厚的触感还有几乎快拧断她手臂的力道让乔若曦震惊又畏惧。
怯怯的，她转回头，又怯怯的看向“大熊”。
“我接受。”
看她似乎呆住的模样，他不自在的清了清喉咙，重复道：“我接受你的告白。”
这下子她是真的哭出来了！

第1章(1)
乔若曦面如死灰。晚餐前的这段时间，店里没有客人，她呆坐在吧台后面，一脸受创的模样，显然还没有从昨天的打击中恢复过来。
“咏欢。”
叶咏欢是她的房客，跟她一起住在咖啡屋楼上，不过最近因为工作的原因，她很少回来。
“嗨，若曦。”
“嗯。”她懒懒的应了一声。
叶咏欢马上感觉到好友的不寻常，若曦虽然个性腼觍，不太擅长跟人说话，不过面对任何人她永远带着温暖的微笑，让人感觉很舒服。“你怎么了？”
乔若曦久久不回答，只是嘴一瘪，眼睛里突然蓄满了泪水。
“到底发生什么事了？你别吓我啊！”看她这样子，叶咏欢更紧张了。
“我……我做了件蠢事……”
听她把发生的事情从头到尾说一遍，叶咏欢的脸上也不禁出现三条线。
她知道若曦暗恋的那个人，他是店里的常客，见过好几次了。当然她也看过那个高大壮硕的男子，他有种很难让人忽略的存在感。
叶咏欢吞了口口水。
“天！你怎么会那么迷糊？那现在怎么办？你有跟他说你搞错了吗？”
“我不敢说。”
叶咏欢懂她的害怕。看那人的样子就不像是那种你说对不起，他会耸耸肩说没关系的人。
“可是，什么都不说的话……难道你打算跟那种人交往？”
乔若曦脸色惨白，一副快要晕倒的模样。
“不……可是、可是我又不知道该怎么说。怎么办？咏欢，我该怎么办？”
“我也不知道，可是早点讲总是比较好。”

“我也知道，可是……”乔若曦垂下头，她当然都知道，只是没有勇气。
她又想哭了。
“呃，你别想太多了。事情可能没想象中的糟糕，只要好好跟他说，我相信那位先生也不至于为难你，搞不好他会觉得整件事很好笑……”叶咏欢的声音渐渐弱了下去，因为连她自己也怀疑那个男人是有幽默感的人。
乔若曦哭丧着脸。“谢谢你。”
拍拍好友的肩，虽然担心，可是叶咏欢自己还有更需要担心的事情呢！
“对不起，若曦，我是回来拿东西的，马上得回去。”
叶咏欢的工作有点接近帮佣，不过情况比较复杂，她是在她前夫的家里做事，那男人是个相当强势霸道，独占欲超强的可怕人物。
“嗯，我知道了，我会想办法解决的。”
叶咏欢上楼没多久，拿了东西就又出门了。
乔若曦一个人在店里，今天生意不好，没什么客人，她的思绪再度回到“那件事”上面。
“我要勇敢一点……咏欢说的没错，事情拖越久就越糟糕，可是要怎么开口呢……不管了！不要想那么多，下次见到他就直接道歉。嗯！就是这样！”
她一个人喃喃自语，时而皱眉，时而咬唇，时而握拳。
“就这样，我决定了！”
咖啡屋的门又再度
content_en:
"Please wait, wait a moment!"
Qiao Ruoxi ran out of the store in a hurry, but the man stopped because of her call.
She was panting and her face was red, but it wasn't just from running.
She always lowered her head, and what caught her eyes were the man's black boots. She didn't have the courage to speak, or even the courage to raise her head. Her heart was pounding, as if it was about to jump out of her chest. The impulse that she had just rushed out of the store didn't know where it went.
She had secretly liked this man for a long time. He was a frequent visitor to the coffee shop. His gentle and elegant temperament, tall and thin body, and handsome face with a sinister smile made her obsessed with him.
She had already decided never to say anything, and she also knew that her conditions were not good enough for others. She was just the owner of a small coffee shop. Her appearance was at best pretty, and she had no special advantages other than cooking and making coffee...
Wow...the more I think about it, the more desperate I become!
But today when she heard that he told his friends that he was going to work out of town and there would be few opportunities to come to the coffee shop to eat in the future, she panicked and she would never see him again!
She has to try! She had to confess, even if she was rejected, it would be better than saying nothing and leaving only regrets.
It's strange, that's what she told herself just now, why is it that the courage she finally mustered up is now flattened like a balloon with a hole in it.
"What's the matter?" The man's deep voice sounded above his head.
Her heart beat faster, she swallowed with difficulty, and her head dropped lower. She couldn't raise her head to look directly at the man. Her face was so red that it was too embarrassing.
"Did we forget something in the store?" Another pleasant male voice said.
She knew she had to speak or he would start to think she was a weirdo.
All right! Go ahead, go ahead!
"I, I like you! I'm sorry, I have liked you for a long time. Every time you come to the restaurant to dine, I can't help but pay attention to you. But, can you please date me?"
There was a long silence after she finished these words.
Qiao Ruoxi closed her eyes, like a prisoner waiting for the death sentence.
"Ahem, are you serious?" The deep voice sounded again, this time seeming a little shy.
"It's true!" She nodded vigorously. "I know what I said bothered you. I'm sorry! You don't have to worry about me. I just want to tell you how I feel."
"No, I won't blame you." The voice was a little panicked. "Since, since you said that——"
Hearty laughter came from the side. "Haha! Not bad! Big Bear, there is such a cute little girl who likes you. You are lucky."
Big, big bear?
Qiao Ruoxi finally noticed something was wrong. A bad premonition arose spontaneously because the man she liked was tall and handsome, but it was difficult to associate him with the nickname "Big Bear". But it was his friend next to him, the tall, muscular man with a crew cut who looked like a gangster boss...
She suddenly raised her head.
Standing in front of her was the sturdy bear man! In the past, he always came to the store with a Gaoyao man. The two seemed to be good friends. He always ate with an expressionless face, and could eat up all the food in three or two times. He rarely spoke, so he looked scary. But now there was a trace of embarrassment on his face, a rare look of panic.
Dead, dead... Could she... No, it seems to be true - she confessed to the wrong person?
Gao Yaonan on the side looked at her with a smile in his eyes. "I didn't expect you to fall in love with Da Xiong. I thought you were afraid of him. Every time you came to the store, you didn't dare to look at him. You would leave quickly after delivering the food. I thought you were frightened by Da Xiong's thick appearance like other girls. It turns out you have a crush on him! Haha... Not bad! Although my friend looks like a bad guy, he is actually a very nice person. He is a boyfriend.An even better candidate. "
Qiao Ruoxi was about to cry.
No, no, no! She doesn't have a crush on him! She is really afraid of him!
How could this happen? She was usually in a daze, but she didn't expect to be so dazed that she made such a mistake. How should she explain now that she was in the wrong place and confessed to the wrong person?
Her face was pale and her whole body was trembling slightly.
"Yeah, I'm sorry...Um, forget what I said! "
She lowered her head, wishing there was a hole in the ground to dig into. Now she just wanted to rush back to the store immediately, forget all about it, forget about this mistake, and then beat her head hard.
What an idiot - she is a hopeless idiot - ugh...
She turned around and wanted to leave, but her arm was grabbed. The thick touch and the force that almost broke her arm shocked and frightened Qiao Ruoxi.
Timidly, she turned her head and looked timidly at the "big bear".
"I accept. "
Seeing that she seemed stunned, he cleared his throat uncomfortably and repeated: "I accept your confession. "
Now she really cried!
Chapter 1(1)
Qiao Ruoxi's face was ashen. During the period before dinner, there were no customers in the store. She sat behind the bar with a traumatized look on her face. It was obvious that she had not recovered from yesterday's blow.
"Yong Huan. "
Ye Yonghuan is her tenant and lives with her upstairs in the coffee house, but recently due to work, she rarely comes back.
"Hi, Ruoxi. "
"Um. "She responded lazily.
Ye Yonghuan immediately sensed that his friend was unusual. Although Ruoxi was shy and not very good at talking to others, she always had a warm smile when facing anyone, making people feel very comfortable. "What's wrong with you? "
Qiao Ruoxi didn't answer for a long time, but her mouth dropped, and her eyes suddenly filled with tears.
"What happened? Don't scare me! "Seeing her like this, Ye Yonghuan became even more nervous.
"I...I did something stupid..."
Listening to her tell her what happened from beginning to end, three lines appeared on Ye Yonghuan's face.
She knew the person Ruoxi had a crush on. He was a regular customer of the store and she had met him several times. Of course, she had also seen the tall and muscular man. He had a presence that was hard to ignore.
Ye Yonghuan swallowed.
"God! Why are you so confused? So what now? Did you tell him you made a mistake? "
"I dare not say. "
Ye Yonghuan understood her fear. The man didn't look like the kind of person who would shrug and say it's okay when you say sorry.
"But if you don't say anything...are you planning to date that kind of person? "
Qiao Ruoxi's face was pale and she looked like she was about to faint.
“No…but, but I don’t know what to say. what to do? Yong Huan, what should I do? "
“I don’t know either, but it’s always better to tell it sooner. "
"I know it too, but..." Qiao Ruoxi lowered her head. Of course she knew it, but she just didn't have the courage.
She wanted to cry again.
“Well, don’t think too much. The matter may not be as bad as you think. As long as you tell him properly, I believe that gentleman will not embarrass you. Maybe he will find the whole thing funny..." Ye Yonghuan's voice gradually weakened, because even she herself suspected that the man had a sense of humor.
Qiao Ruoxi looked sad. "Thank you. "
Patting her friend on the shoulder, although she was worried, Ye Yonghuan had more things to worry about!
"I'm sorry, Ruoxi, I came back to get something and I have to go back soon. "
Ye Yonghuan's job is a bit close to that of a domestic servant, but the situation is more complicated. She works in her ex-husband's house. The man is a very powerful and domineering man with a strong desire for exclusivity.
"Well, I know, I will find a way to solve it. "
Not long after Ye Yonghuan went upstairs, she took her things and went out again.
Qiao Ruoxi was alone in the store,Business was not good today, there were not many customers, and her thoughts returned to "that matter" again.
"I have to be braver... Yong Huan is right, the longer things go on, the worse they will be, but how do you say it... No matter! Don't think so much, just apologize directly next time you see him. Well! That's it!"
She muttered to herself, sometimes frowning, sometimes biting her lip, sometimes clenching her fists.
"That's it, I've decided!"
The coffee house door opens again
